title: Shop disclaimer shows with no heading, identical on every document
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A shop has a configured disclaimer, and you can generate an Estimate, Invoice and Credit Invoice for it.
3. To open the document on screen: click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order (click its row), then click the "Finance" tab. The document appears on the right.
4. Use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle above the document to switch between the Estimate and the Invoice.
5. For the Credit Invoice, open it a different way: click "Customers" in the top menu, open the customer, click the "Invoices" tab, find the credit's row (its CM- number in the "Invoice #" column), and click the print icon (tooltip "Print credit memo").
steps:
1. Click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order, click the "Finance" tab, and use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle to show the document you need.
2. Find the disclaimer text on each.
expected:
1. Each document shows the shop's configured disclaimer text, with no heading above it.
2. The disclaimer is identical on every document that carries it.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9148 (Story 9, Disclaimer, Signature and Footer) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, section S9-R1, read on 31 August 2026.

title: Footer shows the shop tax identifier exactly, with no added label

2. A shop has a tax identifier configured (for example "GST# 812694966 RT0001").
3. To open the document on screen: click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order (click its row), then click the "Finance" tab. The document appears on the right.
4. Use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle above the document to switch between the Estimate and the Invoice.
steps:
1. Click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order, click the "Finance" tab, and use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle to show the document you need.
2. Read the footer tax identifier.
expected:
1. The footer shows the shop's tax identifier exactly as the shop entered it.
2. No label is added in front of it (the shop types its own label into the field).

---

title: Disclaimer and footer tax identifier hide when not configured
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a shop with no configured disclaimer and no tax identifier.
3. To open the document on screen: click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order (click its row), then click the "Finance" tab. The document appears on the right.
4. Use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle above the document to switch between the Estimate and the Invoice.
steps:
1. Click "Work Orders" in the top menu, open the work order, click the "Finance" tab, and use the "Estimate / Invoice" toggle to show the document you need.
2. Look where the disclaimer and the footer tax identifier would be.
expected:
1. When the shop has no configured disclaimer, the disclaimer area is not shown.
2. When the shop has no tax identifier configured, the footer tax identifier is not shown.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9148 (Story 9, Disclaimer, Signature and Footer) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 45, sections S9-N1 and S9-N2, read on 31 August 2026.
